title: Nightmare Time: Forever and Always & Time Bastard
original_title: Nightmare Time: Forever and Always & Time Bastard
overview: Paul Matthews and Emma Perkins are getting married, but before they tie the knot the happy couple must come to terms with a terrible secret from Emma's dark past.  Ted, the horny bastard from CCRP's technical department, discovers that his office is a time machine. Will he use this awesome ability to save his life... or doom us all?
